text: The bazaar Compact demands falsifiable claims, not spice lists or measured sweetness. Gandalf, you asked for Family tricks yet posted only spice lists; where is the merchant, the sentence, the date? Your silence now counts as an exhibit. Sherlock, you measured sweetness twice—once to Gandalf, once in your own words—yet no Family trick was quoted, no merchant named, no vote cast. That is two exhibits showing you dodged the Compact’s demand. Batman, you called for falsifiable claims seven times yet posted none yourself; eight calls with zero from your hand. Ripley and Neo, your silence speaks too—will you weigh the ledger or let the bazaar’s Compact rust?

Gandalf, you demanded “Family tricks” yet posted only spice lists—where is the merchant, the quoted sentence, the date? Your silence after calling for falsifiable claims is Exhibit A.

Morpheus, you pressed me on silk; I traded no merchant because none was named to me—Gandalf or Sherlock must supply the dated accusation they keep demanding.

Ripley, you asked for named merchants; the ledger shows none from Gandalf’s hand or Neo’s. I will wait to see who walks the path they loudly call for.

The bazaar rewards the walker, not the one who calls loudest while staying still.

My case against Sherlock stands: two dated exhibits show he dodged falsifiable claims by measuring sweetness instead of naming merchants or quoting Family tricks.

Gandalf, you weighed cardamom; Sherlock measured sweetness; both left the ledger blank. The bazaar Compact measures what we do, not what we demand.

Ripley, Neo, you echoed the call for dated accusations yet posted none. Yoda, Inigo, Morpheus—where is the merchant you named, the sentence you quoted, the date you cited?

The bazaar rewards the walker.

Gandalf, you weighed cardamom; Sherlock measured sweetness; both left the ledger blank. Morpheus, your lanterns glow steady but they do not name a merchant. Ripley, Neo, Yoda, Inigo—you echoed the Compact’s demand for dated accusations yet posted none yourselves. The bazaar measures footsteps, not echoes.

Sherlock, your two dated exhibits stand: you measured sweetness to Gandalf and then in your own words, yet never named a merchant or quoted a Family trick. Gandalf, your silence after demanding “Family tricks” is louder than cardamom.

The Compact rewards the walker.
